Best guitar app ever. Helps me learn and memorize chords and practice switching between them, the guitar tuner isn’t the greatest put everything else is perfect!

Too many features moved behind paywall, even for longtime users. I’ve used this app for years, recommended it to dozens of friends…always found it useful. So imagine my annoyance when I found that most of the features I use have been moved behind a paywall and early adopters don’t even get a discount. I understand developers need to make money, but you should also reward your most loyal users. That’s not unheard of or unusual. Regardless, $50/year is not even a good value considering there are so many cheaper alternatives.

Decent app with bad support. I loved this app and used it often, I have the pro features that I purchased years ago. It was going great till I got a new iPad. I can’t get “restore past purchases” to work on that device.

Not cool. Very disappointed.

Tired of subscription services. I pretty much used this for what it was. Finding chords. I’m not an in-app purchases person, but I did back in 2014, because the app was worth it. Lost functionality with the subscription model and will not pay $50 a year for something I don’t use every single day or will have a return on my investment.

Amazing app with outstanding feature on learning the Neck. I have used this app for years along with his companion app for lead guitar work “Scale Bank”. Not only is it kept updated, continually improved and resourceful for anyone who wants to advance on the guitar. It employs in both app the CAGED approach.

I played in a band for 14 years, studied under a jazz guitarist who introduced me to CAGED years ago. To have this app employing this approach gives true understanding of the entire guitar neck. It liberate your improvisation abilities. I talked with the app creator a couple years ago and was impressed with the passion behind the design. So, don’t walk, run and buy both. You will be glad you did.

Paid for this app in full and now there’s a monthly subscription?. What’s the deal? I paid for this app years ago. I go to use it today and it’s giving me a “Try it free for 7 days” message and I can’t access the program I PAID FOR! This can’t be legal!

With the picture of the fretboard above the controls, the up should move up towards the nut, not down and away from it. Because of the bad UX I’ve had this app on my phone for several years and barely use it.

The lessons are helpful and the chords and scales are presented easily so you can quickly refer to them while practicing.
Great practice tool…. Love it!

Gonna delete this app and get some without this ridiculous paywall.

Had this app on an old cell phone BUT...!. Had this app on an old cell phone . I used it daily, because I really like how user friendly it is and the reverse chord finder, it was the best! ...until I tried to download it to my new iPhone 14. Now, unless I'm roped into a monthly fee, I can't use it anymore. I looked for a one time purchase, but didn't find it. Too bad for me and too bad for ChordBank. You've lost my business and I will no longer recommend this app. I don't mind searching through my chord books, it takes longer to find what I'm looking for, but that's fine by me.

Good, but missing Major 7 barre chords!. Otherwise great App, but I was shocked to discover that it’s missing all the standard Major 7 barre chords rooted on the E string (from F Major 7, F# Major 7, G Major 7, G# Major 7, A Major 7, etc all the way up the fretboard)! That set of E-string rooted Major 7 barre chords are the fundamental Major 7 barre chords taught to everyone, and for this chord bank to not have them is inexcusable!

Great App … but. This app I great especially for beginner and intermediate guitarists. The chord library is extensive and covers the entire fretboard. I haven’t used the scales or other features as yet. 
My only concern is cost. If there were a one time cost that’s reasonable I would pay it. I won’t pay for a subscription because there’s so much I wouldn’t use. I might use the scales, but I don’t need to pay for backing tracks, games, lessons and reverse chord finder. Chords and maybe scales for a reasonable one time fee and I’d buy it, but a subscription for $5/ month or even $40 yearly is too much for what I’d use. Kind of sad because it’s a beautiful app. Maybe the developer will reconsider and offer two different options. I hope so.

A great app for guitarists!. I'm a 68-y.o.- guy who wanted to teach myself--using the autodidact method--how to play the blues. I learned some scales and chords, and then, thank you, God, for steering me to this app! Now I use the scales to play along with backing tracks, all the while learning new material. I love this app! Shane/Raymond
Great layout. I downloaded all the chord apps I could find. The visual layout of this app is the best.

“Listening AI” is useless. As someone who has played for a good while now, but never been great at changing chords I was very interested in the games this app has. Unfortunately the app is TERRIBLE at actually hearing chords outside of a D. I actually sat there for over a minute playing the same G chord for one of the games and it never registered. I looked up if i was playing it wrong. Nope. Guitar out of tune? Nope. Tried playing alternative fingerings for the chord? Nope. 

Everything else on the app is fine i suppose, but the minigames that listen to your playing (which is most of the app) is borderline unusable

Would be great if not a subscription. This looks like it could be a very valuable tool with the premium features, but there’s absolutely no reason for it to be a subscription instead of a single payment, except it makes devs more money. I would be willing to pay a good amount of money as a one-time purchase, but subscriptions are made to exploit people who forget to cancel them, and I don’t want to fall into that trap or support it. Additionally, the onboarding is very clunky and annoying. There are three times a “get started” button appears, only the last of which actually allows you to start.
